code_lines: /*GENERA RESUMEN DE LA CNF PARA LAS CUENTAS QUE CORRESPONDEN*/
SELECT 	AÑO, C_SI_SCN_N1 AS C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA,SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE (CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN_N1='S.2' THEN N_Cuenta_SCN IN ('Generación del ingreso', 'Cuentas corrientes', 'Cuenta de capital')
ELSE N_Cuenta_SCN IN ('Cuentas corrientes', 'Cuenta de capital') END)
/*GENERA VALORES NETOS DE LAS VARIABLES PARA TODOS LOS SECTORES, EXCEPTO EMPRESAS, CREANDO CODIGO FAME*/
WHEN t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 IN('K.21','P.51','P.52') THEN 'INN' ELSE t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 END) AS C_INST_FAME,
sum(case when t1.C_ENTRADA='D' then t1.DATO*-1 else t1.DATO end) FORMAT COMMA14.2 AS DATO
WHERE t1.C_SI_SCN <>'S.11' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 NOT IN ('B.8','B.9','P.31')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA INGRESO DISPONIBLE BRUTO EN HOGARES, GOBIERNO Y SOC FINANCIERAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'IBD' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_SI_SCN IN ('S.12','S.13','S.14') AND C_INST_FAME IN ('RPR','RPN','INS','PSN','TCN')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA INGRESO DISPONIBLE BRUTO AJUSTADO EN HOGARES, GOBIERNO Y SOC FINANCIERAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'IDJ' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_SI_SCN IN ('S.12','S.13','S.14') AND C_INST_FAME IN ('RPR','RPN','INS','PSN','TCN','TSE')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA AHORRO EN HOGARES, GOBIERNO Y SOC FINANCIERAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AHO' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_SI_SCN IN ('S.12','S.13','S.14') AND C_INST_FAME IN ('RPR','RPN','INS','PSN','TCN','TSE','CFE','AJFP')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA AHORRO EN RESTO DEL MUNDO*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AHO' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*CREA COD FAME PARA PTMO NETO EN HOGARES, GOBIERNO Y SOC FINANCIERAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'CNF' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_SI_SCN IN ('S.12','S.13','S.14') AND C_INST_FAME IN ('RPR','RPN','INS','PSN','TCN','TSE','CFE','AJFP','TKN','INN')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA PTMO NETO EN RESTO DEL MUNDO*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'CNF' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*CREA COD FAME PARA VARIABLES NETAS DE LA CNF DE EMRPESAs*/
WHEN t1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 IN('D.42','D.43') THEN 'R1'
WHEN t1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 IN('D.42','D.43') THEN 'RDUR'
WHEN t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 IN('K.21','P.51','P.52') THEN 'INN' ELSE t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 END) AS C_INST_FAME,
SUM(CASE WHEN t1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN t1.DATO*-1 ELSE t1.DATO END) FORMAT COMMA14.2 AS DATO
WHERE t1.C_SI_SCN ='S.11' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 NOT IN ('B.8','B.9','P.31')
/*CREA COD FAME PARA INGRESO DISPONIBLE EN EMPRESAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'IBD' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*CREA COD FAME PARA RENTAS DE LA PROPIEDAD NETAS RECIBIDAS EN EMPRESAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'RPN' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*CREA COD FAME PARA AHORRO EN EMPRESAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AHO' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
/*CREA COD FAME PARA PTMO NETO EN EMPRESAS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'CNF' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
DELETE FROM CNF_S11 WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('R1','R3');QUIT;
/*JUNTA TODAS LAS TABLAS EN UNA PRINCIPAL*/
SELECT * FROM CNF OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM IBD_TRIM OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM IDJ_TRIM
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AHO_TRIM OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AHO_TRIM_2 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_TRIM
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_TRIM_2 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM IBD_TRIM_S11 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AHO_TRIM_S11
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_TRIM_S11 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_S11 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM RPN_TRIM_S11
DROP TABLE CNF; DROP TABLE IBD_TRIM; DROP TABLE IDJ_TRIM; DROP TABLE AHO_TRIM; DROP TABLE AHO_TRIM_2; DROP TABLE CNF_TRIM;
DROP TABLE CNF_TRIM_2; DROP TABLE IBD_TRIM_S11; DROP TABLE AHO_TRIM_S11; DROP TABLE CNF_TRIM_S11; DROP TABLE CNF_S11; DROP TABLE RPN_TRIM_S11; QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. RENTAS DE LA PRODUCCIÓN*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'RPR' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('RPR') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. RENTAS DE LA PROPIEDAD NETA*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'RPN' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('RPN','RDUR') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. IMPTOS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'INS' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('INS') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. TRANSFERENCIAS CORRIENTES*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'TCN' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('TCN') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. CFE*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'CFE' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('CFE') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. AHORRO*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'AHO' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('AHO') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. TRANSF DE CAPITAL*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'TKN' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('TKN') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. INVERSION*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'INN' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('INN') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. PTMO NETO*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'CNF' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
WHERE C_INST_FAME IN ('CNF') AND C_SI_SCN IN ('S.11','S.12','S.13','S.14')
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
SELECT * FROM  RPR_ECN OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM RPN_ECN OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM INS_ECN
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM TCN_ECN OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CFE_ECN OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AHO_ECN
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM TKN_ECN OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM INN_ECN  OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_ECN
/*GENERA COD FAME PARA ECONOMÍA NACIONAL. INGRESO DISPONIBLE*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,'IBD' AS C_INST_FAME, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INST_FAME;QUIT;
/*JUNTA TABLAS DE ECON NACIOAL CON TABLA DE RESTO DE SECTORES*/
SELECT * FROM  CNF_S1_0 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_S1 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM CNF_TOTALES
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.14' THEN '.FLU.53.10.N.2013.CLP.T' END)) AS COD_FAME,
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
(CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.1' AND C_INST_FAME IN ('CFE','INN') THEN DATO*-1
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.11' AND C_INST_FAME IN ('RDUR','INN') THEN DATO*-1
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.14' AND C_INST_FAME IN ('CFE','INN') THEN DATO*-1
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.13' AND C_INST_FAME IN ('CFE','INN','TSE') THEN DATO*-1
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.12' AND C_INST_FAME IN ('AJFP','INN') THEN DATO*-1
ELSE DATO END) FORMAT=BEST12.2 AS DATO
CREATE TABLE CNF_CARGADOR_1 AS SELECT DISTINCT COD_FAME FROM CNF_CARGADOR_0;QUIT;
SELECT t1.COD_FAME, t1.FECHA, COALESCE(SUM(t1.DATO+t2.DATO),0) AS DATO
LEFT JOIN CNF_CARGADOR_0 t2 ON (t1.FECHA=t2.FECHA) AND (t1.COD_FAME=t2.COD_FAME)
DROP TABLE CNF_CARGADOR_2; DROP TABLE CNF_CARGADOR_1; DROP TABLE CNF_CARGADOR_0; DROP TABLE CNF_S1_0; DROP TABLE RPR_ECN; DROP TABLE RPN_ECN; DROP TABLE INS_ECN;
DROP TABLE TCN_ECN; DROP TABLE CFE_ECN; DROP TABLE AHO_ECN; DROP TABLE TKN_ECN; DROP TABLE INN_ECN; DROP TABLE CNF_ECN; DROP TABLE CNF_S1; DROP TABLE CNF_TOTALES; DROP TABLE RESUMEN_CNF;QUIT;
/* CODIGOS PARA LOS CARGADORES BALANCE FINAL */
/*GENERA COD FAMILIA FAME PARA BCE FINAL Y OP FINANCIERA*/
(CASE WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.2' THEN 60 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.14' THEN 53 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.11' THEN 52 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.13' THEN 20
WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.121' THEN 30 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.122' THEN 41 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.123' THEN 43 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.124' THEN 43
WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.125' THEN 44 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.126' THEN 42 WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.129' THEN 56 ELSE 0 END) AS C_FAMILIA,
t2.C_FAME, (CASE WHEN t1.C_CUENTA='Bce Final' THEN 'STO' ELSE 'FLU' END) AS CUENTA_FAME,t1.N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_ENTRADA,
GROUP BY t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_FAMILIA, t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, CALCULATED CUENTA_FAME,t2.C_FAME, t1.N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, t1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_ENTRADA
ORDER BY t1.AÑO, t1.TRIM, t1.C_SI_SCN, t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1;
/*GENERA COD FAME DE INSTRUMENTO PARA TOTAL EFECTIVO Y DEPOSITOS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AF.20' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_FAMILIA, '200' AS C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME, "Efectivo y depósitos" AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME DE INSTRUMENTO PARA TOTAL TITULOS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AF.30' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_FAMILIA, '300' AS C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME, "Títulos" AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME DE INSTRUMENTO PARA TOTAL PRESTAMOS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AF.40' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_FAMILIA, '400' AS C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,"Préstamos" AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME DE INSTRUMENTO PARA TOTAL ACCIONES Y PART DE CAPITAL*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AF.50' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_FAMILIA, '500' AS C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,"Acciones" AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*GENERA COD FAME DE INSTRUMENTO PARA TOTAL RESERVAS DE SEGUROS*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN,'AF.60' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_FAMILIA, '600' AS C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,"Reservas seguros" AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*UNE TABLAS DE CALCULOS DE VARIABLES ANTERIORES PARA LOS SECTORES*/
SELECT * FROM  RESUMEN_BCE OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AF2 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AF3 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AF4
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AF5 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM AF6
ORDER BY AÑO, TRIM, C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1;QUIT;
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.1' AS C_SI_SCN,C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, 10 AS C_FAMILIA,C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, CALCULATED C_FAMILIA,C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*CREA BALANCES PARA TOTAL DEL SECTOR FINANCIERO*/
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.12' AS C_SI_SCN,C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, 48 AS C_FAMILIA,C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, CALCULATED C_FAMILIA,C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , 'S.123/24' AS C_SI_SCN,C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA,C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1,C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , CALCULATED C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA,C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
/*ELIMINA DE TABLA BALANCES OFIS Y AUX FIN*/
DELETE FROM BALANCE_SECTORES WHERE C_SI_SCN IN ('S.123','S.124'); QUIT;
CREATE TABLE BALANCE_SECTORES_2 AS SELECT * FROM  BALANCE_SECTORES OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM BALANCE_ECN
OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM BALANCE_SF OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM BALANCE_OIF
ORDER BY AÑO, TRIM, C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1;QUIT;
/*CREA VARIABLE TOTAL ACTIVOS/PASIVOS DESDE TABLA ANTERIOR*/

SELECT 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, 'AF' AS C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA,'000' AS C_FAME,CUENTA_FAME,(CASE WHEN C_ENTRADA='D' THEN 'ACTIVOS' ELSE 'PASIVOS' END) AS N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA, C_ENTRADA, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY 'AÑO'n ,TRIM , C_SI_SCN, CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_FAMILIA, CALCULATED C_FAME, CUENTA_FAME,CALCULATED N_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1, C_CUENTA,C_ENTRADA ;QUIT;
CREATE TABLE BALANCE_SECTORES_3 AS SELECT * FROM  BALANCE_SECTORES_2 OUTER UNION CORR SELECT * FROM ACT_PAS_FIN
ORDER BY AÑO, TRIM, C_SI_SCN, C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1;QUIT;
/*ELIMINA DERIVADOS DEL PASIVO DE TABLA BALANCES 3*/
DELETE FROM BALANCE_SECTORES_3 WHERE C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1='AF.34' AND C_ENTRADA='H';QUIT;
SELECT	CATS('F038.',C_FAME,(CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.1' AND C_ENTRADA='D' THEN CATS('.',CUENTA_FAME,'.',C_FAMILIA,'.Z.N.2013.CLP.T')
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.1' AND C_ENTRADA='H' AND C_FAME<>'999' THEN CATS('.',CUENTA_FAME,'.','Z.',C_FAMILIA,'.N.2013.CLP.T')
WHEN C_SI_SCN <>'S.1' AND C_ENTRADA='H' AND C_FAME<>'999' THEN CATS('.',CUENTA_FAME,'.','10.',C_FAMILIA,'.N.2013.CLP.T')END)) AS COD_FAME,
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
/*CRUZA TABLAS DE CODIGOS FAME CON FECHAS A CARGAR*/
/*UNE CODIGOS CON DATOS PARA CARGAR LO QUE CORRESPONDE AL PERIODO. TABLA FINAL DE CARGADORES DE BALANCES Y OP FIN*/
SELECT t1.COD_FAME, t1.FECHA, COALESCE(SUM(t1.DATO+t2.DATO),0) AS DATO
LEFT JOIN BCE_CARGADOR_0 t2 ON (t1.FECHA=t2.FECHA) AND (t1.COD_FAME=t2.COD_FAME)
(CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN IN ('S.123','S.124') THEN 'S.123/24' ELSE C_SI_SCN END) AS C_SI_SCN,
WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.129' THEN 56 END) AS C_FAMILIA,
WHEN C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE IN ('S.123','S.124') THEN 'S.123/24' ELSE C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE END) AS C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE,
WHEN C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE='S.129' THEN 56 END) AS C_FAMILIA_CA,
WHERE 	C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1 IN ('AF.30','AF.31','AF.32') AND C_ENTRADA='D' AND C_CUENTA IN ('Bce Final','Financiera')
GROUP BY AÑO, TRIM,	CALCULATED C_SI_SCN,CALCULATED C_FAMILIA,CALCULATED C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE,CALCULATED C_FAMILIA_CA,C_CUENTA
ORDER BY AÑO, TRIM, CALCULATED C_SI_SCN;
DELETE FROM RESUMEN_AF3 WHERE C_FAMILIA_CA=52 AND C_FAMILIA=20;*/DELETE FROM RESUMEN_AF3 WHERE C_FAMILIA_CA=30 AND C_FAMILIA=53; QUIT;
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
CREATE TABLE TIT_CARGADOR_1 AS SELECT DISTINCT COD_FAME FROM TIT_CARGADOR_0;QUIT;
/*CRUZA COD FAME DE WTW BONOS CON PERIODOS*/
/*CREA TABLA FINAL DE CARGADOR WTW BONOS*/
SELECT t1.COD_FAME, t1.FECHA, COALESCE(SUM(t1.DATO + t2.DATO),0) AS DATO
LEFT JOIN TIT_CARGADOR_0 t2 ON (t1.FECHA=t2.FECHA) AND (t1.COD_FAME=t2.COD_FAME)
(CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN IN ('S.123','S.124') THEN 'S.123/24' ELSE C_SI_SCN END) AS C_SI_SCN,

SELECT YEAR(FECHA) AS AÑO,(CASE WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=3 THEN 1 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=6 THEN 2 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) AS TRIM, 'S.11' AS C_SI_SCN, 'Cotizada' AS T_TIPO,'STO' AS C_CUENTA, SaldoFinal/1000 AS DATO FROM TABLAS.ACC_COT WHERE Nombre="Soc No Financieras"

SELECT YEAR(FECHA) AS AÑO,(CASE WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=3 THEN 1 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=6 THEN 2 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) AS TRIM, 'S.122' AS C_SI_SCN, 'Cotizada' AS T_TIPO,'FLU' AS C_CUENTA, Transaccion/1000 AS DATO FROM TABLAS.ACC_COT WHERE Nombre="Bancos"

SELECT YEAR(FECHA) AS AÑO,(CASE WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=3 THEN 1 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=6 THEN 2 WHEN MONTH(FECHA)=9 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END) AS TRIM, 'S.122' AS C_SI_SCN, 'Cotizada' AS T_TIPO,'STO' AS C_CUENTA, SaldoFinal/1000 AS DATO FROM TABLAS.ACC_COT WHERE Nombre="Bancos" ;
/*GENERA ACCIONES NO COTIZADAS DE EMPRESAS Y BANCOS*/
WHERE (t1.'AÑO'n = t2.'AÑO'n AND t1.TRIM = t2.TRIM AND t1.C_SI_SCN = t2.C_SI_SCN AND t1.C_CUENTA = t2.C_CUENTA);
/*GENERA BASE FINAL DE ACCIONES COTIZADAS Y NO COTIZADAS DE BANCOS Y EMPRESAS*/
/*GENERA CARAGDOR DE ACCIONES DE EMPRESAS Y BANCOS*/
SELECT CATS((CASE WHEN T_TIPO='Cotizada' THEN 'F038.503.' ELSE 'F038.502.' END),C_CUENTA,(CASE WHEN C_SI_SCN='S.11' THEN '.10.52.N.2013.CLP.T' ELSE '.10.41.N.2013.CLP.T' END)) AS COD_FAME,
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
/*INFORMACION ADICIONAL DE LOS FONDOS DE INVERSION DEL GOB*/
SELECT AÑO, TRIM, C_SI_SCN,'AF.T' AS C_Instrumento, C_CUENTA, 'Total inversiones' AS N_Info, SUM(DATO) AS DATO
GROUP BY AÑO, TRIM, C_SI_SCN,CALCULATED C_Instrumento, C_CUENTA, CALCULATED N_Info;QUIT;
/*JUNTA INVERSIONES TOTALES DEL GOBIERNO CON INFO FEES Y FRP*/
/*GENERA CARGADOR DE INVERSIONES DEL GOBIENRO CON COD FAME*/
SELECT (CASE WHEN C_Instrumento='AF.T' AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' THEN 'F038.004.STO.20.10.N.2013.CLP.T'
WHEN N_Info='FRP' AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' THEN 'F038.002.STO.20.10.N.2013.CLP.T'
WHEN N_Info='FEES' AND C_CUENTA='Bce Final' THEN 'F038.001.STO.20.10.N.2013.CLP.T'
WHEN N_Info='FEES' AND C_CUENTA='Financiera' THEN 'F038.001.FLU.20.10.N.2013.CLP.T' END) AS COD_FAME,
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
/*DATOS DE DEUDA DE EMPRESAS NO FINANCIERAS*/
/*SELECCIONA DEUDA DESDE FACTORING Y CRED COMERCIALES EXTERNOS QUE SON DEUDA DE EMPRESAS*/
WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.123' THEN 'Factoring' END)	AS N_FAME,

WHERE (CASE WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.123' AND t1.N_SI CONTAINS 'Factoring' AND t1.C_CUENTA=('Bce Final') THEN t1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1='AF.7' AND t1.C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE in ('S.11','S.99')
WHEN t1.C_SI_SCN='S.2' AND t1.C_CUENTA=('Bce Final') THEN t1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND t1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN_N1='AF.7' AND t1.C_SI_SCN_C_AGENTE IN ('S.11','S.99') END)
/*UNE A DEUDA DE FACTORING Y CRED COMERCIALES EXTERNOS, LA DEUDA SECURITIZADA DESDE INFO ADICIONAL*/
SELECT AÑO, TRIM, 'Factoring' AS N_FAME,DATO FORMAT=COMMAX12.2  FROM TABLAS.INFO_ADICIONAL
/*GENERA CARGADOR DE EMPRESAS CODIFICANDO LA DEUDA OBTENIDA ANTERIORMENTE*/
SELECT (CASE WHEN N_FAME='Factoring' THEN 'F038.700.STO.43.52.N.2013.CLP.T' ELSE 'F038.700.STO.60.52.N.2013.CLP.T' END) AS COD_FAME,
CATS((CASE WHEN TRIM IN (1,4) THEN '31' ELSE '30' END),'-',(CASE WHEN TRIM=1 THEN '03' WHEN TRIM=2 THEN '06' WHEN TRIM=3 THEN '09' ELSE '12' END),'-',AÑO) AS FECHA,
GROUP BY CALCULATED COD_FAME, CALCULATED FECHA;

SELECT DISTINCT 'F038.700.FLU.42.10.N.2013.CLP.T' AS COD_FAME, FECHA, 0 AS DATO
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE CARGADOR_RATIOS AS
